codecrafters.catalog.description: Shown when the user is browsing the catalog of challenges.

codecrafters.challenge.description: Shown when the user is viewing the overview of a challenge (e.g. Build your own Redis).

codecrafters.solvingChallenge.description: Shown in privacy mode when the user is working on a stage of a challenge.

codecrafters.solvingStage.description: Shown when the user is working on a stage whose name couldn't be read.

codecrafters.settingUp.description: Shown when the user is setting up the repository of a challenge (language and git setup).

codecrafters.completed.description: Shown when the user has just completed a challenge or one of its extensions.

codecrafters.tracks.description: Shown when the user is browsing the list of language tracks.

codecrafters.track.description: Shown when the user is viewing a language track (e.g. Rust).

codecrafters.leaderboard.description: Shown when the user is viewing the leaderboard of a language.

codecrafters.concepts.description: Shown when the user is browsing the concepts (short interactive articles).

codecrafters.walkthrough.description: Shown when the user is reading a code walkthrough.

codecrafters.contests.description: Shown when the user is viewing the contests.

codecrafters.roadmap.description: Shown when the user is voting on upcoming challenges in the roadmap.

codecrafters.membership.description: Shown when the user is viewing the membership plans, gifts or perks.

codecrafters.badges.description: Shown when the user is viewing the badges they can earn.

codecrafters.buttonViewChallenge.description: Button that opens the overview of the challenge being solved or viewed.

codecrafters.buttonViewTrack.description: Button that opens the language track being viewed.
